% Table \ref{tab:map-comparison-friedman}. p_holm is Holm-Bonferroni corrected
% within each metric's family of 3 pairwise tests only (not pooled across
% metrics). Effect size r is the matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation
% (range -1 to +1); sign follows the comparison direction shown (positive =
% first-named condition higher). Median Delta, Wilcoxon W statistic, and
% n_nonzero_diff are in the source CSV but omitted here as audit-trail detail
% not needed in the main appendix table.

\vspace{4pt}
\footnotesize
F1, precision, and recall show a median paired difference of exactly 0.000 for all three contrasts, at both the pooled level and for every one of the 12 models individually (\texttt{study\_0/map\_comparison\_by\_model.csv}) -- this is not contradicted by AST-vs-none reaching significance for F1 and precision (and AST-vs-AST-compact for precision): the Wilcoxon signed-rank test is sensitive to the sign and rank of the \emph{nonzero} differences, which for these contrasts skew consistently positive even though more than half of any given model's 25 matched pairs tie exactly. Read as a real but subtle population-level effect too small to shift any single model's own median, not as an artefact of pooling.\\
\textsuperscript{a}Cached tokens are a subset of input tokens, not an additive quantity.
